definition: LTX is a family of generative artificial intelligence video models, developed by Lightricks..
details: LTX is a family of generative artificial intelligence video models, developed by Lightricks.
story: Think of a jazz musician who has heard so many solos that a new one simply falls out of their fingers. Given a starting line, the machine imagines what comes next — a word, a note, a patch of a picture. It makes new things by recombining everything it has ever seen. Creation, here, is memory recombined at speed. That next-word, next-stroke magic is LTX (world model).
